profiles.title: Docs / Governance Only
profiles.use_when: Markdown, roadmap, changelog, ADR, contributor, security, ownership, or release-process docs change without runtime behavior.
notes: Regenerate docs/changelog/index.md after adding a changelog file.
Run broader repo-sanity when docs also touch generated contracts, examples, or source references.

profiles.title: Config / Schema / Examples
profiles.use_when: Config fields, config registry, Desktop ConfigWire, Android ConfigStore, examples, platform defaults, or parity matrix change.
notes: If readiness rules or repair targets changed, also run the readiness contract profile.
Android JVM tests remain CI/pre-provisioned; local profile uses static Android guards.

profiles.title: Android UI / Mobile Bridge
profiles.use_when: Android Compose UI, Android config import/export, JNI bridge, VPN lifecycle, support snapshot, localization, or mobile diagnostics change.
notes: Do not run Gradle locally unless intentionally working in a provisioned Android environment.
CI owns Android JVM execution; local guards prevent common drift without creating Gradle caches.

profiles.title: Backend Helpers / Relay Scripts
profiles.use_when: Apps Script helpers, Cloudflare Worker bridge, Vercel/Netlify relay docs, compatibility markers, or backend registry docs change.
notes: Syntax-check Apps Script helpers through repo-sanity when Node is available.
Backend docs must keep Apps Script, Serverless JSON, XHTTP, direct fronting, and full tunnel distinct.

profiles.title: Desktop / Rust Runtime
profiles.use_when: Rust runtime, Desktop UI, Doctor/status contracts, readiness, LAN sharing, mode behavior, or support bundle behavior changes.
notes: Use powershell fallback for readiness generation if pwsh is not installed.
For UI behavior changes, check Desktop/Android/docs vocabulary together.

profiles.title: Full Tunnel / tunnel-node
profiles.use_when: Full mode, tunnel-node, UDP/udpgw, batching/coalescing, tunnel drain behavior, or CodeFull/tunnel-node docs change.
notes: Mixed TCP/UDP and EOF-tail behavior are concurrency-sensitive; run tunnel-node tests for implementation changes.
Full-mode user verification is end-to-end through the proxy and tunnel-node, not the Desktop Test Relay button.

profiles.title: Release Ready
profiles.use_when: Before tagging or publishing a public release, or after broad cross-platform changes.
notes: CI remains authoritative for official artifacts and Android JVM tests.
If local Node or PowerShell is unavailable, use documented repo-sanity skip flags only for local triage, not release signoff.
